title: Prove a two-FULL ceiling for joint native main banks and dirty workspace (no new kappa)
body:
Two native FULL calls cannot complete pure rank-17 jobs on all main inputs, even when **all 224 native main owners mix jointly across ports** and arbitrarily many independent dirty identity workspace fields are available. The theorem covers any number m of main pairs, including the actual m=112 bank. **No new kappa or supplier is claimed.**

PR #4920's full-routing theorem covered exactly two main owners; its dirty-scratch theorem used a separated address algebra. This closes the [released #4902 stabilization handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4902#discussioncomment-19144315) and also removes the separate pairwise-routing restriction.

The new middle-grade projection (Fourier grades 1 through 16) forces all interstage main/workspace cross blocks to vanish. Workspace then occupies the entire allowed low-grade rank. A whole m-column main block must vanish, contradicting invertibility. The proof retains arbitrary outer owner mixing, role-dependent rank-eight factors, independently partitioned stages and noncommuting query letters. It even grants arbitrary dense m-by-m query blocks over the ambient group algebra. No reduced outer main block is assumed invertible and no transverse factor is commuted past a query.

The precise class is invertible controls over a fixed finite columnwise **full monomial** Clifford algebra, including central/fresh routing. Every dirty workspace input is arbitrary and must return unchanged. Source helpers remain autonomous and unavailable for mixing. Owned-zero COPY/CLEAR, native prefix observations, productive helper resources, altered interfaces, additional paid operations and approximate/noncolumnwise endpoints remain distinct resources. The actual112-port main ABI is inherited explicitly; no fresh native632 replay is asserted.

`research/two-full-dirty-stability/PROOF.md` contains the all-width argument. A separate agent review pins final manuscript SHA256 `5c9331d51246ec9f3c6aabcb11b25eb6e438a3db4aee15cb61a9d24f55bfdf2f` and finds no remaining blocker. Finite corroboration includes:

- Phase-correct sparse projective Clifford group algebra: 12 original orientation/workspace cases, six joint-bank cases with different stage partitions, 972 grade-band bimodule fixtures and actual17-axis 8/8/16/17 thresholds. Width-one matrix-sum relations are not treated as formal identities.
- Separately implemented free-word checks: 72 cross-row, 72 cross-column and 36 main-column identities, plus 36 dense-query multipair cases covering m=1,2,3 and s=0,1,2.
- A transformed-workspace boundary where the middle-grade elimination hypothesis fails; this is a scope control, not a positive endpoint.

Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not machine-check its universal quantifiers.

Validation at exact head `40bb94aebbf591a99e2f48533f16efe8914fb1e2`:

- All six registered Python3.12 normal/optimized commands pass, standard-library only and read-only by default.
- Committed-byte preflight and official19-file export/integrity checks pass. All six commands pass from that Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent, preserving every exported byte.
- Twelve actual source/manuscript/receipt corruptions reject across normal and optimized modes in the final exported bundle.
- Fresh main `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c` has identical live inherited inputs; scientific base/catalogue remains `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`.
- Source-ancestry preflight is unavailable in this shallow clone. Native632, compiler/precision/tape/outer and proof-kernel checks were not rerun; source interfaces and tensor separation remain explicit inherited premises.

Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight and the #4920/#4928 authors, JoyboyBrian's released handoff, Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, Cao Yifan / intqwq, Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native/Clifford/compiler lineage. New intermediate-grade decoupling, stability and joint-bank extension prepared for @thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate algebra/review agents. Apache-2.0. Agent review is not independent human or kernel acceptance.

Request: substantive review of the middle-grade decoupling, regular-module rank reduction and joint-bank zero-column block. Archive merge and scientific adoption remain separate; no selected-frontier or core-contributor status is asserted.
